BiblicalUsage: Healing here is wholeness restored, and God promises it to His people again and again. Isaiah says when you loose the bonds of wickedness your health shall spring forth speedily, Jeremiah says I will restore health unto thee and heal thee of thy wounds, and again, I will bring it health and cure, and reveal the abundance of peace and truth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word is a promise with God's name on it: He is the one who restores health, not the physician and not the nation. The wounds are ours, the healing is His, and I hold that the health He promises is whole, body and land and people together.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
